        12                  SENATOR FOLEY:    Thank you,

        13       Mr. President.

        14                  Today is a very important day for

        15       our firefighters throughout the State of

        16       New York.  Today, with the adoption of this

        17       resolution, we'll be reinstating the exemption

        18       for our firefighters to operate our large

        19       heavy equipment throughout the State of

        20       New York as it relates to fire districts.

        21                  This is something that has enjoyed

        22       broad support, geographically and also within

        23       this chamber and the chamber in the Assembly.

        24       It's one of these instances where it crosses



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4747



         1       party lines with broad bipartisan support, not

         2       just on the adoption of the measure but also

         3       on the cosponsorship.

         4                  So I'm very, very pleased to have

         5       worked with our colleagues here in the Senate,

         6       along with a number of, let's say, interested

         7       parties throughout this state, from northern

         8       portions to the City of New York to Long

         9       Island, where in one voice we are saying thank

        10       you to our firefighters and giving back to

        11       them something that they had enjoyed for

        12       decades, and that is this particular

        13       exemption.

        14                  What's most, let's say, noteworthy

        15       and timely is the fact that by passing this

        16       today, and with unusual speed, it's my

        17       understanding that the Governor will sign this

        18       into law so that all the fire departments

        19       throughout this state will be able to

        20       participate fully in this coming weekend's

        21       Memorial Day parades, which we know is part

        22       and parcel of the culture of so many

        23       communities within this state, as it is within

        24       our country.
